lessons.goal: 結合調查方法、數據與提案，評估主張是否合理。

questions.evidence: [Survey summary] The art club asked twenty students leaving its exhibition whether the school should hold more art events. Sixteen said yes, three said no, and one was unsure. The club's draft report states, 'Eighty percent of all students want more art events.'
questions.prompt: How many surveyed visitors answered yes?

questions.evidence: [Method note] Students were questioned only at the exhibition exit between three and four. No students who stayed away from the exhibition were contacted. The school has four hundred students. The report's missing second page contains these details.

questions.evidence:
[Survey summary] The art club asked twenty students leaving its exhibition whether the school should hold more art events. Sixteen said yes, three said no, and one was unsure. The club's draft report states, 'Eighty percent of all students want more art events.'

[Method note] Students were questioned only at the exhibition exit between three and four. No students who stayed away from the exhibition were contacted. The school has four hundred students. The report's missing second page contains these details.

[Council response] The result tells us about these twenty visitors. It does not establish the views of the whole school. Please include the method page and seek responses from students with different activities before making a school-wide claim.

The art club keeps the original numbers but changes its wording. It proposes one small trial event while collecting broader feedback. Its members learn that a limited survey can still be useful when the group described by the conclusion matches the group actually questioned.
questions.explanation: 只有受訪的二十位觀展者能直接由資料描述。
options: Eighty percent of all four hundred students wanted more events.
Students who missed the exhibition had no opinion.
Sixteen of the twenty surveyed exhibition visitors wanted more art events.
Only four students in the school opposed more art events.

questions.evidence: The art club keeps the original numbers but changes its wording. It proposes one small trial event while collecting broader feedback. Its members learn that a limited survey can still be useful when the group described by the conclusion matches the group actually questioned.
questions.explanation: 修正結論範圍可保留有限但真實的受訪結果。
options: The missing method page cancels every recorded response.
A high percentage always represents the whole school.
A trial event proves the survey was representative.
Its conclusion can be limited to the people actually questioned.
questions.prompt: Why can the original survey still be useful?
